description: Site Object Structure for Apptio export.
title: SITE

siccode.title: Standard Industrial Classification
siccode.remarks: Describe the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) of the industry, such as manufacuring or transportation.

contactgroup.title: Site Contact Group
contactgroup.remarks: Default person group at the site for approving work to be done.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the site, for example, Toronto IT Operations Center. To enter of view additional information, click the Long Description button.

contact.title: Site Contact
contact.remarks: Default person at the site for approving work to be done.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Identifies the site with a short code, for example, TORONTO, for a company's Toronto, Canada site. This value must be unique for all sites.

changeby.title: Changed By
changeby.remarks: User name who last changed record.

naicscode.title: North American Industrial Classification
naicscode.remarks: Describe the North American Industry Classification (NAICS), such as utilities or oil and gas extraction.

active.title: Active
active.remarks: Specifies whether the site is active. If this check box is selected, the site is active and can be used wherever a site is specified in Maximo. It the check box is cleared, the site is inactive and will not appear when you use the select value function.

indstrydesc.title: Industry Description
indstrydesc.remarks: Describe the industry (such as the construction industry).

plusgopenomuid.title: Open Unique Idenfitier
plusgopenomuid.remarks: The open unique identifier provided to an external system by Maximo.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization identifier for this site

avenumofempl.title: Annual average number of employees
avenumofempl.remarks: The annual average number of employees.

hasld.title: Has Long Description
hasld.remarks: Boolean flag to indicate if there is any long description for this record

tothrswrkd.title: Total hours worked by all employees last year
tothrswrkd.remarks: The total hours worked by all employees last year.
